10.2.82 BswMSwitchIPduMode
SWS Item
[ECUC_BswM_00958]
Container Name
BswMSwitchIPduMode
Parent Container
BswMAvailableActions
Description
This container includes all parameters related to the selection of the transmission mode
an I-PDU to be sent by COM. Com_SwitchIpduTxMode is called when this action is
configured.
Configuration Parameters
SWS Item
[ECUC_BswM_00960]
Parameter Name
BswMSwitchIPduModeValue
Parent Container
BswMSwitchIPduMode
Description
This parameter defines which transmission mode shall be selected during this call.
This parameter corresponds to the parameter "Mode" of the function Com_SwitchIpdu
TxMode.
Multiplicity
